item.title: Interview with a Medical Device Engineer
item.description: Pleased to share the transcription for an interview I did for Vital Signs magazine, a publication by and for hospital workers in Bristol, UK. We touched on numerous topics, including global supply chains, the abstraction of hospital labor into monetary concerns, engineer and scientists subjectivities, worker organizing, medical device design paradigms, speculation about communism, and more.

item.title: Forest and Factory: The Science and the Fiction of Communism
item.description: This essay was written with my friend Phil Neel in order to try and answer the question of how communism might actually work. We find existing attempts to do this largely unsatisfactory, chiefly for their refusal to engage with the material-productive reality of this world and the constraints this reality poses on building a new world.
